description: Source code for a Grove Light Sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing ADC reading, sensor data conversion, and device initialization.

methods.name: gls_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches ADC sample data for the sensor.

methods.name: gls_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw ADC data to lux value and populates sensor_value structure.

methods.name: gls_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, configures ADC channel.
